content:
August has arrived, with $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and the AirTag 2 all-time low deals still going strong. But leading off today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the M5 MacBook Air—we spotted a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, but we are also tracking up to $300 off select configurations over at the official Apple Certified Refurbished store, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details on that here). Rounding things out we have nearly $100 off various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the new Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in Black down at just $18, and a chance to snag the Transparent Red Beats Solo Buds for as little as $40. All the details are below.

August AirPods deals go up to $100 off: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $119 (originally $179) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy rolls out August Back to School sale: Apple gear, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrades, more

Official Apple Refurbished Store now has the lowest prices on M5 MacBook Air, up to $300 off

While price hikes on the latest MacBook lineup have already landed at retail, and we've tracked quite a few deals up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering one of the best prices we've seen on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've already recommended the lowest priced base model from reputable sources, but you can also score the 24GB 15-inch model right now for $300 below its new retail price, with Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue color options.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,699 with free shipping. As noted above, the offer applies to all four colorways: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air has a new retail price of $1,900, and right now all configurations are going for over $1,999 at Amazon.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999) — $300 off

Today's Apple Refurbished Store offer brings this machine back to its older pricing and marks the best discount we've tracked since the price hike went into effect. Given the current situation, these new MSRPs are likely to hold through the end of the year, if not longer. So while this isn't the lowest price ever, it's a very solid money-saving opportunity for anyone looking to jump into the M5 MacBook Air lineup this year—we likely won't see prices like this again on the next MacBook Air lineup until mid-2027 or later.

Browse all MacBook deals at Apple's refurbished store here—use the filters on the left-hand side of the page to select the model you're looking for.

Best price yet: 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air drops to $200 off today

Ongoing: 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees massive $500 price cut at Amazon today

MacBook prices have indeed just gone up, but Amazon is still offering a massive $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning. The price is close to the best we've tracked before the price hike took effect. Details below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Considering this machine regularly goes for $2,999 at Apple and elsewhere, that's a true $500 discount. The deal applies to both the Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best deal we've tracked on the M5 Pro model since retailers raised prices.

Before today, Amazon's highest discount on this machine was $300, but now there's an additional $200 off.

It's not quite the lowest price we tracked before the price hike, but that's out of our control—there's no going back. Factoring in the price increase that took effect about a month ago, this deal is only $100 off our all-time M5 Pro low.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models discounted nearly $100 at Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has now also reduced prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium case with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band, with nearly $100 off. Details below.

While deals on the Series 11 lineup have been steady, as we're seeing now in early August, discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been much rarer. However, this morning we spotted Amazon offering the Black Ultra 3 with a Black Unity Sport Band for nearly $100 off.

Amazon is now selling the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the coordinating Black Ocean Band for $699.99 with free shipping.

The regular price is $799, so this price represents a nearly $100 discount and is the best deal we've found on a new unit from a reputable retailer.

Aside from a brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this matches the best price of the year and is one of the few notable price drops we've tracked at Amazon.

At the time of writing, the Black model with the Ocean Band is the only configuration with a significant discount. But if this discount follows the same pattern as last time, we're likely to see other color configurations drop in price throughout today and the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

If you're after the Series 11, you can grab one for much less right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

New Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in Black drops to all-time low of $18 with free shipping for Prime members (40% off)

Score Transparent Red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

We were seriously impressed by the built-in battery life on the Solo Buds—currently the most affordable wireless earbuds Beats makes. However, at $80 retail and regularly $70 at Amazon, they're even more appealing at $41 with free shipping from Best Buy. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals here, and more Solo Buds deals below.

Best Buy is now selling open-box Transparent Red Beats Solo Buds in "excellent" condition for $40.99 with free shipping. That's roughly half the suggested retail price and well below Amazon's $70 price for new units.

  • Functionality and appearance like new.
  • Includes all parts and accessories. Packaging may differ or may not be provided.

You're choosing a fairly entry-level pair of earbuds, but we're talking about current-generation earbuds from Apple's Beats brand for $41.

As noted above, in our testing these earbuds deliver up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge from the built-in battery. While it's not a wireless charging case design, for most users the $41 price point paired with that battery life is more than enough. Other features include one-touch seamless pairing, custom microphones with "advanced noise-learning algorithms" for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
